title: SEG Requirement Node
description: Schema for a Requirement node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Maps to spdx:Requirement. Sourced from repo A (sphinx-needs .rst files). Authored by the Requirements Engineer.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this requirement. Form: {namespaceBase}/req/REQ-{number}. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Requirement on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable requirement identifier. Must match the ID suffix in spdxId.

description.description: The full requirement text body as authored in sphinx-needs.

seg:nodeHash.description: Cryptographic hash of this node's content. Computed by the extractor over the sphinx-needs item text body and fields. A change to this value marks all outgoing edges suspect.

hashValue.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA256 digest. Must be exactly 64 characters.

seg:merkleHash.description: Merkle hash for this node. Computed by the proof generator as H(nodeHash || sorted(merkleHash of dependencies via strong-propagation edges)). Absent until the first proof generation run that includes this node.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Fixed to repoA for all Requirement nodes. Resolves to the concrete repo URL defined in config.json.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo A to the .rst file containing this requirement.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
